change: Added a canonical legal/status footer strip with absolute production URLs and created dedicated public pages for terms, cookies and system status.
reason: Footer legal/status links must be consistently available across public pages without duplicating footer markup per page.
implementation: assets/stijl.js injects the legal strip sitewide when absent
assets/blok-voet.html and index.html contain the canonical strip directly
legal/status documents live under pages/ for delivery classification
safeguards: all newly added href attributes use full production URLs
system status performs bounded browser-side checks only
root_cause: A material website change can be functionally correct while delivery remains blocked when new files are outside classified website paths, PR Change-Scope is stale, or mandatory closure evidence is absent.
prevention_rule: For material website changes, keep implementation paths inside a classified delivery lane, declare every changed path in Change-Scope, and add canonical learning, activity-ledger and human change documentation before terminal merge.

evidence.expected: material website delivery compiles one immutable scope with closure evidence before terminal writer handoff
